query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_anomalies,
  SUM(CASE WHEN jpyPrice IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as null_jpyprice_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN jpyPrice IS NOT NULL AND jpyPrice < 5000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as very_low_jpy_count,
  MIN(CAST(price AS DECIMAL)) as min_hkd,
  MAX(CAST(price AS DECIMAL)) as max_hkd
FROM priceHistory
WHERE grade IN ('PSA10', 'PSA 10')
  AND (jpyPrice IS NULL OR jpyPrice < 5000 OR CAST(price AS DECIMAL) < 300);
